data.narrative: Instrumented full production observability across structured JSON logging, Prometheus RED Golden Signals, and actionable alerting rules. Built cardinality-safe route labeling, caught and fixed an Express array-route labeling bug during empirical testing, hardened log sanitization to redact inline URI credentials, and demonstrated clear mastery of pillar correlation and alert fatigue trade-offs.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed observability telemetry to emit JSON strictly to stdout/stderr and expose pull-based /metrics so containerized instances remain stateless and cloud-native.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured GET /metrics and stdout JSON logging requiring zero local log file rotation inside the container.

dimension_scores.observation: Created an automated verification harness testing metrics counters, histogram buckets, gauges, log correlation, and alert rule integrity as a repeatable quality gate.
dimension_scores.evidence: Authored scripts/verify-module-04-observability.ts validating 10 mixed requests including 500 error correlation.

dimension_scores.observation: Covered all RED Golden Signals (Rate via http_requests_total, Errors via status label, Duration via http_request_duration_seconds histogram) plus in-flight and business queue depth gauges and correlated JSON logs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified /metrics output, structured logs with timestamp/level/message/service_name/request_id, and 3 PromQL alerts in infra/alerts.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Proactively caught both an inline credential leak in error strings and a high-cardinality Prometheus label risk, resolving them before production exposure.
dimension_scores.evidence: Hardened sanitizeLogString with regex scrubbing ://user:pass@ to ://[REDACTED]@ and normalized dynamic routes (/r/:code, /links/:id).

dimension_scores.observation: Tuned alert rules with sustained 'for' durations (2m error rate, 3m p95 latency, 1m down) and distinct severity levels to prevent pager fatigue during transient hiccups.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured HighErrorRate (critical, 2m), HighLatency (warning, 3m), and ServiceDown (critical, 1m) with runbook links in infra/alerts.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored clear, actionable alert annotations with templated metrics, human-readable impact statements, runbook pointers, and structured diagnostic records.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented actionable PromQL alert definitions in infra/alerts.yml and full verification artifacts in progress/module_04_verify_proof.json.

strengths: Cardinality-safe Prometheus engineering: normalizes dynamic routes and keeps unbounded IDs strictly inside structured logs
Defense-in-depth log sanitization: actively scrubs inline URI credentials alongside secret keys and CRLF injection vectors
Empirical debugging discipline: caught and fixed an Express array-route metric labeling bug via an automated verification harness
data.recommendation: Use these golden signals and structured logs in Module 05 to observe exact system behavior when deliberately breaking backing dependencies during failure mode analysis.

public_evidence.ability: Prometheus Golden Signals & Cardinality-Safe Metrics Instrumentation
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Provides real-time visibility into traffic rate, error ratios, tail latency, and queue saturation without risking TSDB memory exhaustion.

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Balances rapid incident detection against pager desensitization using sustained duration clauses and runbook-linked annotations.

teaching_approaches.detail: Verified end-to-end 500 error propagation across structured logs, Prometheus counters, and alert math.
